Microscope slides can be prepared for viewing with a light microscope to show the different stages of meiosis in plant cells.

In the male reproductive organ of plants, meiosis takes place in cells known as pollen mother cells.

Fig. 4.1 and Fig. 4.2 show photomicrographs of two different stages of meiosis in pollen mother cells from a lily plant, *Lilium*.
